system.description:
Many low-generation Setite elders no longer need the illusions of Obfuscate to appear as a god; through this power, a Setite physically metamorphoses into the form of a god. Male Followers of Set generally take the form of Set himself, or the crocodile-headed Sobek, or the wolf-headed Wepwawet. Female Setites generally assume the form of the cobra-headed goddess Renenet or the hippopotamus-goddess Taweret. A vampire has only one Divine Image form (unless she buys this power twice); the divine ancestors, the player and the Storyteller decide which form manifests.

You exchange three Blood Traits for four Physical Traits and two Willpower Traits, plus the Social Trait Intimidating and the negative Social Trait Bestial. The transformation lasts one scene or one hour, whichever is shorter. Generational limits do not apply to the Traits gained this way.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.duration: Full scene or one hour, whichever is shorter
